university.name: Durham University
university.summary: Collegiate research university in Durham, North East England, teaching undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across the arts and humanities, sciences, social sciences and business. Applicants from outside the UK are assessed at the overseas fee rate and can also join through the Durham University International Study Centre.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor (gov.uk register of licensed sponsors: students, file dated 2026-09-10, listed as University of Durham)

scholarships.name: Durham Inspiring Excellence Scholarship (Postgraduate Taught)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 or GBP 10,000 tuition fee discount, applied directly to tuition with no cash alternative
scholarships.summary: Partial tuition discount for self-funded overseas-fee students starting a one-year, full-time, in-person taught MSc, MA, LLM or MDS in September 2027. A limited number of awards is made in competitive rounds. MBA, MSW and MA Theology and Ministry are excluded.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee status; self-funded with no other Durham or external scholarship or sponsorship; applied to an eligible programme and meets its entry requirements; starting September 2027; not progressing through the International Study Centre; scholarship form submitted. Selection uses the form responses, academic achievement, potential for positive impact, and nationality and programme balance.
scholarships.deadline_note: Round 1: 2026-12-07; Round 2: 2027-03-15; final round: 2027-05-01 (all 23:59 GMT). A complete postgraduate application is needed first, but an academic offer is not. Earlier unsuccessful or unconsidered applicants roll into the next round automatically.
scholarships.notes: The page does not name Pakistan; it is open to any applicant with Overseas fee status. value_amount records the higher of the two award levels.

scholarships.name: Durham Inspiring Excellence Scholarship (Undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 or GBP 10,000 off tuition each year (up to GBP 15,000 or GBP 30,000 over three years), applied directly to fees
scholarships.summary: Partial tuition discount for self-funded overseas-fee students starting a full-time, in-person undergraduate degree in September 2027. A limited number of awards is made in competitive rounds. Renewal depends on academic progress. Two Theology degrees are excluded.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee status; self-funded; valid UCAS Personal ID; Durham chosen as Firm Choice; meets entry requirements; not admitted through Clearing or the International Study Centre; scholarship form submitted. Renewal needs a pass in all modules with 60% overall for the GBP 5,000 award and 70% overall for the GBP 10,000 award.
scholarships.deadline_note: Scholarship form rounds: 2026-12-07, 2027-03-15 and final 2027-05-01 (all 23:59 GMT). UCAS equal consideration deadline 2027-01-13 at 18:00 UK time. A UCAS offer is not needed to submit the form.
scholarships.notes: The page does not name Pakistan. One selection sentence on the page refers to completing a postgraduate degree, which looks like a drafting error on the undergraduate page; the client should confirm the selection wording.

could_not_verify: International tuition fees for every course: Durham course pages show the fee only as an image, and the text states that fees for the selected year have not yet been confirmed. The fees pages (undergraduate, postgraduate taught, international) direct readers to the course database and publish no overseas taught figures. The 2025-26 fee summary PDF lists home fees only.

Course-level English language band: course pages link to the general requirements page and the subject-to-band mapping was not retrievable. Band scores themselves were read (Direct Entry Band A: IELTS 7.0 with 6.5 minimum; Band B: IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 minimum; Band C: IELTS 6.0 with 5.5 minimum) but cannot be assigned to a course.
Pakistan country entry requirements for undergraduate courses: the country list on the course page was cut off before Pakistan.
